title: FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit
features: Magnetic V-buckle design for secure chin strap attachment
Universal compatibility with most motorcycle helmets
Quick-release mechanism for easy adjustment and removal
description:
Engineered to seamlessly integrate into modern helmet speaker cavities, the FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit from FIDLOCK provides riders with uninterrupted acoustic clarity and group connectivity. Built with IP67 Certified Dustproof & Submersion Resistant (All-Season Waterproof Seal), it boasts an installation rating of 2.5 / 10 (Clamp-mount or 3M VHB base with recessed speaker cavity routing).

The FIDLOCK V-Buckle Magnetic Chin Strap Kit represents an indispensable touring and group-ride upgrade from FIDLOCK. Its robust audio tuning and rock-solid weather sealing provide riders with effortless navigation cues and reliable connectivity across arduous highway tours.
